def parity(x: int) -> int:
    """Parity of x: 0 if even, 1 if odd (never negative)."""
    post out == 0 or out == 1
    ex parity(4) == 0
    ex parity(7) == 1
    ex parity(-3) == 1
    return x % 2

def parities(xs: list[int]) -> list[int]:
    """Parity (0 or 1) of each element of xs, computed in parallel, in input order."""
    post out.len() == xs.len()
    ex parities([1, 2, 3, 4]) == [1, 0, 1, 0]
    ex parities([]) == []
    return par [parity(x) for x in xs]
